text: It's week three. The slides keep piling up, the exam date keeps getting closer, and honestly, you're not sure you actually understand any of it.
So you do what everyone does. You read it again. And again. It feels like studying. But re-reading does very little for memory. Recalling the idea is what makes it stick.
Then exam week arrives, and what you need isn't more pages. You need to know what you remember, and what you don't, before the exam finds out first.
That's why we built Sunroot. A study app that turns the material you already have into something you can actually learn from.
Maybe your lecturer's class is already there. Find it, join it, and the whole course is laid out for you. Chapter by chapter, ready to read.
Press start, and the lesson reads out loud. Every word lights up as it's spoken, and Sprout moves with it, so you never lose your place.
Stuck on an idea? Ask the tutor in your own words. Or tap Teach me, and get it as a short lesson, scene by scene.
And if nothing's set up yet, bring your own slides, a PDF, or a photo of handwritten notes. Within a minute, they become clean, structured study notes.
Then comes the part that makes it stick. Quiz yourself. Flip flashcards. Write answers in your own words. The result shows the moment you answer.
Got one wrong? Good. That's useful information. Sunroot keeps it in your mistake notebook, sends you back to the idea, and tests you again with a fresh question.
Spaced review brings back what you're about to forget. And the exam planner builds your revision backwards from your exam date.
Some ideas need to be seen. So there are virtual labs, and a maker studio, where you can build and test circuits without buying a single part.
And you don't have to do it alone. Study in focus rooms with friends, and climb a weekly leaderboard that resets, so newcomers can win too.
Because understanding isn't about reading more. It's about practising the right way, at the right time. Sunroot does that part with you.
Sunroot. Understand it. Build it. Prove it. Find it at sunrootlearn.com.
